**Claim:** `domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_012u2pRjcqAYtoEjgr3wwhnK` · branch `claude/issue-5476-surface-deeplink-live-channel` · round 5.

## PM route call: **A**, with B as the documented fallback

Triage put the A/B/C fork to execution-seat discretion twice and recommended A. I am ruling **A — a live target channel alongside the mount-time capture** — for the reason triage gives and one more:

- A is the **missing half the module's own doc comment already describes**, so it closes a declared-but-unbuilt gap rather than adding a mechanism.
- B adds a *second* navigation mechanism next to the deep-link one. This lane has spent four cards this session on exactly that shape — one contract with several independent implementations (#5477, #5542, #5562, #5587). Choosing B here would author the next one deliberately.

**If, on measurement, A cannot be done without changing what the other three pillars observe, stop and report before landing** — the card itself notes A "changes a contract four pillars share", and that is the one thing here that could warrant escalation rather than a route swap. Do not silently fall back to B; say so and let me rule.

**C is off the table** — it is what ships today.

## Binding requirement, whichever route survives

The sheet is shared with the Home / draft-preview bar, where "the Studio object editor" may not be a reachable destination at all. **The link must degrade to prose off-Studio**, and that degradation is a test assertion, not a comment. An implementation that renders a dead link outside Studio is worse than the prose it replaced.

## Verified surface

```
packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/useSurfaceDeepLink.ts        the plumbing
packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/useSurfaceDeepLink.test.ts   existing pins
packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx      the only other consumer
```

The mount-time capture the card quotes is the `React.useRef(parseSurfaceParam(...))` — re-read it in place; the ref exists deliberately so later in-pillar selections do not re-trigger a restore, and **whatever you add must not break that**. A live channel that re-fires the restore on every selection would be a regression, so pin the existing behaviour as a control alongside the new one.

## Scope and grading

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/**` plus a changeset. Polish class, scheduled behind the user-reachable defect cards in this lane — it is dispatched now because those have landed. Size M per triage.

Clause ②: not tripped unless you add an export; if your route needs one, stop and report first.
